      Campus Shelf — prototype

      This build demonstrates every planned feature end to end in the browser: login, department/course/semester search, wishlist, favorites, notifications, chat, ratings & reviews, reporting, ISBN lookup and barcode scanning, smart price suggestions, file preview, semester archiving, and admin verification with a stats dashboard. For the real deployment: Firebase Authentication replaces the format-only email check, Firestore persists listings, reviews, chat, wishlist, favorites, and notifications so they survive a refresh and sync between real users, Firebase Storage hosts uploaded files properly, and server-side rules restrict the Admin panel to real admin accounts.

      All data here lives only in this browser tab and resets on reload. Notifications shown are global to this demo session, not routed to a specific logged-in user, since that routing needs a real backend.
